metadata.title: Clicked like I was sneezing and somehow landed a 1 kill?! Valorant logic is broken again
metadata.description:
Me: sneezing mid-game like it’s a hazard
Enemy: probably deleting their account after that
How did I even hit that? No clue but I’m taking it
If your aim’s a lovable accident, this one’s for you

Tap if your aim cheats more than your brain!
